summary: Shows referencing variables with Jinja2 double curly braces, e.g. in a template dest path, and notes Jinja2 loops and conditionals are allowed in templates but not in playbooks, which are pure YAML.
questions: How do I reference a variable in a playbook?
Can I use Jinja2 for loops inside a playbook?

answer_card.title: Referencing simple variables
answer_card.answer_md:
Use double curly braces:

```yaml
ansible.builtin.template:
  src: foo.cfg.j2
  dest: '{{ remote_install_path }}/foo.cfg'
```

Jinja2 loops and conditionals work in **templates**, not in playbooks; playbooks are pure YAML, so you can't create a loop of tasks with Jinja2.
